name: TheDawn

components.pose: Medium, graceful ascent: she rises upright out of a huge opening blossom at a steady unhurried pace, arms open wide and slightly forward with palms up as if gathering the morning, head lifted and gaze to the camera, a gentle joyful smile; full figure from head to toe visible.
components.effects: Petals, seeds and spores swirl upward around her, vines and flowers uncurling as she rises, motes of green-gold light drifting through the sunbeams.

notes: THE DAWN: the sister rising from the Sundering in her element's homeland - first look at her territory. Her dragon is not yet bound, so no companion; native creatures instead. Rise speed and energy differ per sister.
